This kinase is subsequently targeted by multiple compounds, including propylamine, ascidiathiazone B, and astersaponin F, all of which are linked to LAPC4. The shared target of these compounds implies a potential mechanism of action involving the modulation of this kinase, which could influence LAPC4 activity. The evidence supports a pathway where the compound may act through a common target, possibly by activating or inhibiting the kinase, thereby affecting LAPC4 function. The integration of these findings suggests a possible role for the compound in modulating LAPC4 through a kinase-dependent mechanism, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
